description: This file is part of SuiteCRM, a Customer Relationship Management system derived from SugarCRM. It sets up access control, verifies request parameters, includes the SubPanel class, and initializes a SubPanel object to generate and display a search form for a specific subpanel related to a module.

classes.name: SubPanel
classes.description: A class responsible for handling subpanel display and operations within the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SubPanel object with module, record, subpanel name, layout definition key, and collection.

methods.name: getSearchForm
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the search form of the subpanel.
